full_prompt_en: A square hand-painted animation background shows a steep neighborhood lane descending between closely packed, weathered buildings beneath a vivid summer sky. Deep cobalt blue fills the upper middle, while towering white cumulus clouds billow on the right, their shaded folds pale blue rather than gray. On the left, a tall cluster of irregular concrete and stucco buildings rises in stacked setbacks, with small balconies, exposed pipes, dark windows, and rust-stained patches breaking the off-white walls. A broad green tree partly hides the lower levels, its dense foliage painted in many short olive and dark green strokes. On the right, a lower building with an orange tiled roof and peeling cream walls frames the other side of the narrow route; nearby branches and another low roof fill the lower corner. Utility poles stand along the middle distance, and thin wires cut diagonally across the sky and between the buildings. The pale, sloping road begins at the lower center, drops sharply into a tighter urban cluster, and is occupied by two small light-colored vehicles near the foreground. Cracks, steps, curb edges, and patches of vegetation keep the lane lived-in without overwhelming the strong perspective. Clear midday sunlight falls from above, bringing bright cream highlights to walls, roof tiles, and roadway, while the underside of balconies and the tree canopy hold cooler green-gray shadows. The paint surface is matte and finely textured, with precise architectural edges softened by irregular color and leafy brushwork. The overall composition draws the eye downhill through a dense, warm neighborhood, balancing crisp built forms and foliage against an expansive blue and white sky.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形手绘动画背景呈现一条陡峭的街区小路，在紧密排列的风化建筑之间向下延伸，上方是鲜明的夏日天空。深钴蓝色占据上部中央，右侧巨大的白色积云层层鼓起，其背阴褶皱呈浅蓝而非灰色。左边一簇高大的混凝土与灰泥建筑以参差退台叠起，小阳台、外露管线、深窗和锈迹打断灰白墙面。一株宽阔绿树遮住部分低层，茂密树冠由许多橄榄绿与深绿短笔画成。右侧，一栋有橙色瓦顶与剥落奶油色墙面的较低建筑框住小路另一边；近处枝叶和又一座低屋顶填充右下角。电线杆沿中景竖立，纤细电线斜切天空并穿行于楼房之间。浅色斜路从下方中央开始，陡然降入更紧凑的城区，前景附近有两辆小浅色车。裂纹、台阶、路缘和零散植被使道路有生活痕迹，却没有压倒强烈的透视。清澈正午阳光从上方照下，为墙壁、屋瓦和路面带来明亮奶油色高光；阳台底部与树冠则保留较冷的绿灰阴影。颜料表面哑光而细致，精确建筑边缘被不均匀色彩和枝叶笔触略微柔化。整体构图引导视线穿过密集而温暖的街区向坡下走，以清楚人造形体与植被平衡宽广蓝白天空。
style_prompt_en: The image has a matte hand-painted background finish, with structured perspective and detailed built textures softened by visible, irregular brushwork. Strong cobalt and cloud-white areas open above compact cream, ochre, terracotta, and deep green masses. Fine linear elements cross larger blocks, adding lived-in rhythm without disrupting their readability. Foliage is built from layered short strokes; weathering appears as stains, chips, and uneven pigment rather than smooth surface noise. High daylight creates clean highlights and cool shaded recesses, giving the scene volume while preserving its illustrative character. The overall treatment feels bright, spacious, and quietly inhabited despite dense detail.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有哑光手绘背景的表面效果，结构清楚的透视与丰富的建筑纹理又被可见而不规则的笔触柔化。强烈钴蓝和云白色在上方敞开，下面聚集紧凑的奶油色、赭黄、陶土色与深绿形块。细线性元素穿过更大的色块，增加生活节奏，却不破坏其可读性。叶丛由层叠短笔构成；风化表现为污痕、剥落和不均匀颜料，而非光滑的表面噪点。明亮日光制造清楚高光与冷色背阴凹处，使场景有体积，同时保留插画性。整体处理在细节密集之中仍明亮、开阔，带有安静的居住气息。
theme_en: A steep sunlit neighborhood lane under a brilliant summer sky
theme_zh: 灿烂夏日天空下，一条陡峭而明亮的街区小路
name: 电影感动画景观背景
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
